strategy.primary: Voltron with Garza as the damage source: ramp out a seven-mana commander, make her damage lethal (Basilisk Collar, Quietus Spike, Thornbite Staff, Chandra's Ignition, Nova Flame) so each kill grows her, and close with commander damage, infect or extra combats.
strategy.secondary: Equipment card flow (Robe of the Archmagi, Mask of Memory, Sword of Fire and Ice, Curiosity) and compact closers: Kediss + Grafted Exoskeleton, Hatred, Jeska tripling power, Sword of Feast and Famine or Reaver Cleaver + Aggravated Assault.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Garza Zol, Plague Queen
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Flying, haste
Whenever a creature dealt damage by Garza Zol this turn dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Garza Zol.
Whenever Garza Zol deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card.

identity.why: Grows from creatures she damaged dying; draws on player hits.
Deathtouch turns every Garza ping into a kill.
Repeatable ping that untaps Garza on each death.
With an infect Garza, poisons every opponent at once.
Garza-sourced board wipe that grows her.
